claim_scope_note: The only claim addressed by this packet is C-FRESHNESS (owner_lanes graph/runtime/product). This is a feasibility/design experiment testing whether a D1V population spanning >=2 credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript GET-only anchors can be constructed via a materially different anchor population or instrument redesign. No false-accept guard bound is measured as an outcome; only constructability and the structural blockers.

director_mandate_binding.binding_strategic_question: Given that transport-value coupling is confirmed time-stable across two independent capture dates and the anchor-clustered bootstrap is certified non-degenerate, can a value-only-rotation (D1V) population spanning >=2 credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript GET-only anchors be constructed - either by admitting a materially different anchor population whose transport validators (ETag, Last-Modified, Cache-Control max-age, Vary, final_url) are provably independent of the rotating value, or by an instrument redesign that decouples body-derived validators and token-bearing final_urls from value rotation - such that M-N-D1V-ANCHORS >= 2 and the anchor-clustered 97.5% lower bound of the incumbent value-blind guard's false-accept differential is non-degenerate, or if not constructible, should the four-anchor Part II route be PARKed?
director_mandate_binding.mandate_escape_clause: If no such population/redesign is constructible on the credential-free GET-only substrate, the experiment must record the decisive bounded reason for non-constructability and the recommendation to PARK the four-anchor Part II route.
director_mandate_binding.treatment_of_parent_handoff: SUPERSEDE. The parent handoff EXP-GRAPH-37992949248 is continuity evidence only. Its proposed remedies are the options to be systematically evaluated here.

parent_handoff_continuity.disposition: SUPERSEDE as authorization. Retained as continuity evidence only.

question: Can a D1V (value-only rotation) population spanning >= 2 credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript GET-only anchors be constructed, either by admitting a materially different anchor population with transport validators independent of the rotating value, or by an instrument redesign that decouples body-derived validators and token-bearing final_urls from value rotation?
hypothesis: H-CONSTRUCT: Either (a) there exists a materially different anchor population (>=2 anchors meeting inclusion criteria) whose transport validators (ETag, Last-Modified, Cache-Control max-age, Vary, final_url) are provably independent of the rotating value, enabling M-N-D1V-ANCHORS >= 2, or (b) an instrument redesign (decoupling body-derived ETag from body value or decoupling token-bearing final_url from value rotation) yields M-N-D1V-ANCHORS >= 2 on a feasible population while preserving the frozen D1V definition and credential-free GET-only substrate. H-NOT-CONSTRUCT: No such anchor population and no feasible instrument redesign satisfy all inclusion constraints (credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript, GET-only), so M-N-D1V-ANCHORS >= 2 is not constructible and the four-anchor Part II route should be PARKed.
falsifier: F-CONSTRUCTABLE: Discovery of >=2 anchors meeting all criteria with M-N-D1V-ANCHORS >= 2 under the chosen construction (population-based or redesign-based), with non-degenerate anchor-clustered estimator controls passing for the population. F-NOT-CONSTRUCTABLE: Systematic search over candidate populations and documented instrument redesigns fails to produce >=2 anchors satisfying all criteria; all candidates are blocked by transport-value coupling or substrate constraints, and estimator controls confirm the degeneracy is attributable to population (not estimator).

baselines.description: The original four anchors (CAL-POS-1..4) with frozen transport signature
Systematic screening of candidate credential-free GET-only anchors against transport independence criteria
baselines.expected_behavior: May yield >=2 anchors with transport validators independent of value rotation, or zero

baselines.description: Alternative D1V/transport extraction strategies that decouple body-derived validators from value rotation
baselines.expected_behavior: May render transport_change insensitive to value rotation for previously blocked anchors, or may violate substrate constraints

positive_control: PC-ESTIMATOR-CAPABLE: Apply same anchor-clustered estimator positive controls (GATE F) to any candidate population with >=2 anchors - heterogeneous 2-anchor fixture must yield non-degenerate positive-width interval.
null_control: NC-TRANSPORT-INDEPENDENCE: For any candidate anchor in D1V population, demonstrate transport validators (ETag/LM/Cache-Control/Vary/final_url) do not vary as a deterministic function of the rotating value under the proposed construction.

measurement_validity.requirement: This is DESIGN ONLY. No outcome-bearing measurements of guard false-accept rates are performed. All feasibility checks are pre-freeze satisfiability/constructability assessments.
For design_contract_version==2, all six freeze_eligibility checks must be addressed with PASS or justified NOT_APPLICABLE; freeze_artifacts must list all mutable local dependencies.
Candidate anchors must satisfy: credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript, GET-only. Any proposed instrument redesign must preserve these constraints.
The D1V definition, transport_signature fields, and guard structure remain frozen as defined; redesign means decoupling strategy, not redefining semantics.

decision_rule: DECISION-CONSTRUCTABLE if >=2 anchors form a D1V population with M-N-D1V-ANCHORS >= 2 and transport validators provably independent of value rotation, passing estimator capability controls. DECISION-NOT-CONSTRUCTABLE if systematic search yields no such population and all instrument redesigns are infeasible while satisfying constraints; in this case recommend PARKing the four-anchor Part II route and redirecting C-FRESHNESS to alternative objective.
product_consequence_positive: Enables non-degenerate guard false-accept measurement for freshness, potentially allowing validation/refinement of C-FRESHNESS with measurable bounds.
product_consequence_negative: Confirms four-anchor Part II route cannot power the non-degenerate read under the frozen definitions; avoids wasted EXECUTE cycles on structurally degenerate population and directs effort to alternative approaches.
estimated_cost: LOW (design/feasibility assessment; no large-scale measurement runs planned in DESIGN)
expected_information_gain: HIGH (resolves the blocking degeneracy question decisively, preventing uninformative EXECUTE attempts)
